title: Health Minister's Discretionary Grant (HMDG) Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Financial assistance for treatment/hospitalization for indigent patients in specified circumstances; it is assistance rather than a conventional insurance policy.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Indigent patients meeting the notified financial/medical and treatment conditions; assistance is subject to applicable ministry guidelines and limits.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Health Minister's Discretionary Grant (HMDG).

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
